_documentation.purpose: Test whether a laser kept 17.5 nm ahead of a tracked vortex transports it farther than a stationary laser, with dark and thermal-cutoff controls.
_documentation.relies_on: Builds configs/simulations/nbn_optical_vortex_unpinned.json for the 100 nm film, NbN material, two-temperature heat dynamics, and Heun TDGL. The 17.5 nm, 500 nW, 10 nm spot settings follow the optical-gradient sweep; that sweep crossed Tc near 5.1 ps, so this run has a subcritical thermal cutoff.
_documentation.authority: This file sets the feedback experiment. The referenced simulation supplies the material, mesh, timestep, and solver controls; this runner sets the field, seed, laser, and zero applied current.

fields.simulation_config: Simulation JSON providing geometry, material and physics solver settings.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular applied magnetic field in tesla.
fields.initial_vortex.x_fraction: Initial vortex x divided by film width; off-node seed improves winding detection.
fields.initial_vortex.y_fraction: Initial vortex y divided by film height.
fields.initial_vortex.charge: Topological winding sign of the initial vortex.
fields.initial_vortex.core_radius_cells: Initial core radius measured in grid cells.
fields.seed_position_m: Physical seed location in metres, used to find the prepared vortex.
fields.absorbed_power_W: Film-absorbed laser power in watts. The default 500 nW is exploratory and may reach Tc on longer runs.
fields.spot_sigma_m: Gaussian spot standard deviation in metres.
fields.maximum_electron_temperature_K: Stop an illuminated branch at this peak electron temperature, below material Tc, to avoid claiming motion through a normal spot.
fields.controller.offset_m: Desired vector from tracked vortex core to laser center, in metres. Here the beam stays ahead in +y.
fields.controller.max_speed_m_s: Maximum beam-center speed, in metres per second; prevents the feedback beam from jumping to a newly measured position.
fields.controller.update_every_steps: Number of accepted physical steps between laser-command updates.
fields.controller.measurement_delay_updates: Additional accepted vortex measurements of latency before feedback uses a center position; zero uses the most recent accepted state.
fields.timing.dark_steps: Laser-off preparation steps before cloning the same state into dynamic, stationary, and dark branches.
fields.timing.exposure_steps: Maximum physical steps per branch; branches may stop earlier at the thermal cutoff.
fields.output.frame_every: Steps between saved film frames used for snapshots and the GIF.
fields.output.zoom_radius_cells: Half-width of the cropped core/beam view in mesh cells.
fields.output.gif_enabled: Whether to render a time-resolved film GIF for the dynamic branch.
fields.output.gif_fps: Playback frames per second; does not change simulated time.
fields.output.dpi: Image resolution for figures and GIF frames.
fields.output_directory: Base result directory; a numbered sibling is reserved for each run.
